newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED BEAT WIMBLEDON TO GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED BEAT WIMBLEDON TO GO TOP.

text.p: Manchester United came from behind to beat Wimbledon 2-1 on Wednesday -- a result which takes them top of the English premier league for the first time this season.
The defending champions leapfrogged over arch-rivals Liverpool, who were not in action. Andy Cole scored the United winner seven minutes from the end.

Newcastle also fought back from a goal down, scoring four times in the last 16 minutes to beat Everton 4-1 at St James' Park to give manager Kenny Dalglish his first league victory since he took over from Kevin Keegan earlier this month.
Arsenal won 2-1 at neighbours West Ham to join Liverpool on 46 points, a point behind United. Newcastle remain fourth on 42 points.

In the night's sole League Cup tie second division Stockport came from a goal down to triumph 2-1 at premier league Southampton in a quarter-final replay. Substitute Andy Mutch scored their winner in the 83rd minute.
Stockport face premier league Middlesbrough in the semifinal.
